# UW Computer Sciences User Pages

> Directory of faculty, researchers, and staff profiles at UW-Madison Computer Sciences, plus educational tutorials on data structures and programming.

This site serves as a central hub for the University of Wisconsin-Madison Computer Sciences department, hosting personal and research pages for faculty and students. It includes both professional profiles spanning areas like wireless networking, computer graphics, and databases, as well as educational resources on algorithms and software testing.

## Key Topics

- Faculty Profiles
- Data Structures
- Wireless Networking
- Computer Graphics
- IoT Systems
- Database Systems
- Network Routing
- Binary Search Trees
- Red-Black Trees
- Java Programming
- Unit Testing
- Lambda Expressions
- Algorithm Complexity
- Biometric Authentication
- User Directory

## Faculty & Researcher Profiles

- [Mridul Aanjaneya](http://pages.cs.wisc.edu/~aanjneya): Faculty profile in computer graphics, physics simulation, and scientific computing
- [Ali Abedi](http://pages.cs.wisc.edu/~abedi): Faculty profile in wireless networking, IoT, and battery-free systems
- [Adel Ardalan](http://pages.cs.wisc.edu/~adel): PhD researcher profile in database systems and data integration
- [Ahmad Abdull Rashid](http://pages.cs.wisc.edu/~ahmad): Research profile on Kinect-based biometric authentication and gesture recognition
- [Anubhavnidhi Abhashkumar](http://pages.cs.wisc.edu/~anubhavnidhi): PhD researcher profile in network routing, policy, and verification
- [David Aeschlimann](http://pages.cs.wisc.edu/~daeschli): Student profile and research intern in Paradyn project at UW-Madison

## Data Structures & Algorithms

- [Binary Search Tree](http://pages.cs.wisc.edu/~abduljelil): Educational guide on binary search tree data structures and algorithms
- [Red-Black Trees](http://pages.cs.wisc.edu/~manal): Educational resource on red-black trees, rebalancing, and algorithmic complexity
- [Insertion in a Red-Black Tree](http://pages.cs.wisc.edu/~anisha): Tutorial on red-black tree insertion and self-balancing algorithms

## Java Programming & Testing

- [JUnit](http://pages.cs.wisc.edu/~abiprojo): Tutorial guide on JUnit Java testing framework and unit testing practices
- [Lambda Expressions](http://pages.cs.wisc.edu/~adhami): Beginner tutorial on Java 8 lambda expressions and functional interfaces

## Department Directory

- [UW Computer Sciences User Pages](https://pages.cs.wisc.edu): UW Computer Sciences user directory and faculty/staff home pages index

## Optional

- [Eric Aderhold](http://pages.cs.wisc.edu/~aderhold): Personal profile and contact information for software engineer Eric Aderhold
- [Welcome to my Travel Diary](http://pages.cs.wisc.edu/~barnabas): Personal travel diary documenting experiences in Malaysia, Australia, and Asia
